example.title: Box culvert carrying Spring Creek under 458 Avenue
example.place: northeast of Wakonda, Clay County, SD
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Spring Creek bridge, 458 Avenue (Clay County, South Dakota))

brief: Modern twin-cell cast-in-place reinforced-concrete box culvert of 2009 under a paved county road: two square cells separated by a centre wall with a haunched top, a plain headwall with the year cast in a recessed panel, and flared concrete wing walls with sloped tops; delineator posts at the road edge. It replaced an older concrete arch bridge commemorated by a roadside historical marker. Winter snow, open farm country. Fits a growing exurban street crossing.
